name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: Dedicated Main Tab: Time of day mode (Day, Evening, Night, Auto) and instant real-time language switcher
Dedicated Wallpaper Tab: All 14 wallpaper categories preserved with checkboxes, interval, calendar font, and scaling
Dedicated Dock Tab: Dock placement, root folder, icon size selector (16/24/32/48/64 px), sorting, and auto-hide delay
Font Accordion Selector: Expandable panel with 12 curated fonts for Dock Folders, Dock Items, and Wallpaper Calendar
Real-Time Localization: Immediate dynamic translation of Settings window and System Tray context menu on language switch
Apply Button Added: Dedicated Apply button to commit and test changes without closing the settings window
